nodes.label: ADR-0006: Memory embeddings & retrieval
nodes.rationale: gemini-embedding-001 truncated to 768 dims (Matryoshka) — under pgvector's 2000-dim ANN limit, compact, ample quality at personal-OS scale. Embeddings always go to Gemini regardless of MODEL_PROVIDER. Hybrid retrieval = relevance(cosine OR keyword) x confidence x recency. Conflict resolution by subject: a new record supersedes the old, never a silent overwrite.
